$comment: M68: versioned content contract for data/<namespace>/dungeon_room/*.json. Identity is the resource id namespace + the relative path with the .json suffix stripped (for example data/mypack/dungeon_room/hall_tee.json is the room mypack:hall_tee, and data/mypack/dungeon_room/sub/deep.json is mypack:sub/deep). Two packs may ship the same local name in different namespaces and both load; two packs shipping the same namespaced id resolve by pack priority, the higher priority pack winning and the loser reported as superseded. The parser is DungeonRoomMeta.fromJson; this schema documents that contract, it is not enforced by a runtime JSON Schema validator.

version.$comment: Content contract version this file declares. 1 is the only generation this round ships. A mismatched version is rejected at load with the file named, never silently coerced.

template.$comment: Structure template id, a fully qualified resource location such as pocketdungeons:rooms/hall_tee. Must resolve to a loaded structure or the room is rejected with 'template not found: <template>'. A third party room points at its own namespace's template; it does not secretly require a pocketdungeons template.

footprint.$comment: [x, z] cell count. Only [1, 1] is generated today; multi cell footprints are a later generation.

roles.$comment: Closed set of five. The generator's own switch logic understands exactly these; a sixth string is rejected at load.

theme.$comment: Theme ids this room is eligible for. Empty matches every theme. Each entry is a theme id: a qualified id (namespace:path, for example mypack:deepslate) or a legacy unqualified id (for example deepslate) that resolves to pocketdungeons:deepslate when that built in exists. A bare name that is not a pocketdungeons built in is an unresolved legacy reference and is reported, never silently last file wins.

processors.$comment: Id of a vanilla processor_list. Rejected at load with 'processor list not found: <processors>' if it is not in the registry.

content.$comment: Situation id dispatched by RoomContent at stamp time. A situation id is itself a namespaced content reference with the same legacy resolution rules as a theme id; the shipped situations live under the pocketdungeons namespace.

spanY.$comment: M61: the number of cell sized volumes this room stacks vertically, the topmost being its own cell. 1 is no lower story, 2 owns the cell plus the 16x16x9 volume beneath. The legacy field name 'stories' is NOT an alias for spanY and is never silently substituted; a file carrying 'stories' instead of 'spanY' is read as spanY 1 with 'stories' preserved as an unknown field for recovery.

situationTag.$comment: Closed vocabulary of fifteen. Anything else is rejected at load with the room and the offending tag named.
